name: Grand Prix de l'automobile Club de France

nar.text: The starting order had been decided by ballot. The cars were sent away at 1½-minute intervals.

Fabry (8B Itala) took a corner too fast at Vibraye and his wheels collapsed causing him to topple over.
Le Blon runs off the wooden road at St. Calais and crashes; he and his mechanic start repairing the buckled rear wheel.
Civelli de Bosch, held to 30 km/h by his unfinished Grégoire, retires; Hanriot also drops out with engine trouble.
Baras leads after the first lap, ahead of Duray and Szisz.
Over the full distance of the lap Brasier's Baras was the quickest; his lap time of 52 minutes and 25.4 seconds (52:25.4) moved him up to third position on the road and into the lead overall.

After 12h14m07s, the red Renault of Szisz was first to cross the finish line, which was confirmed by the trumpet signal.
Nazzaro (2B F.I.A.T.) arrived 32m19.4s behind in second place and Albert Clément (13A Bayard-Clément) followed only 3m20.4s behind
He held on to the lead until the third lap, when Szisz took over first position, defending it to the finish.

He took the black flag of the winner at the finish line after a combined total from the two days of 12:12:07.0; he had also been quicker on the straight than any other driver, reaching a top speed of 154 km/h.
